svg.title: Thirty Days to a Documented Brokerage Operating System
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-first-thirty-days-roadmap; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to a Documented Brokerage Operating System; subtitle: Build executable mandates and pipeline evidence, not an invented first-month close.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are cumulative milestone days: 7, 14, 21, and 30. Work begins only within an authorized service scope. Licensing, seller readiness, and diligence can extend the schedule. The canonical first-deal window remains 3–12 months; these milestones do not forecast commission receipts.; caption: End the sprint with an auditable mandate process, qualified counterparty records, a tested document workflow, and a cash plan that survives missed closing dates.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Define the niche, permitted activities, and cash constraints.; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Select one asset category and operating jurisdiction; document license and securities analysis, excluded activities, escrow arrangements, and a 13-week cash forecast. Complete the four statutory and risk checks before launching brokerage outreach.; label: Days 8-14; value: Install the mandate packet and controlled evidence workflow.; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Prepare the exclusive engagement, scoped NCNDA, agency disclosures, seller questionnaire, buyer qualification checklist, and document index. Configure HubSpot stages and SharePoint access, then test a sample record without real client funds.; label: Days 15-21; value: Run a bounded owner-research and buyer-matching pilot.; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Research 25 relevant owners and 15 plausible buyers as activity targets, not conversion promises. Log authority, sector fit, acquisition criteria, contact permissions, and evidence gaps. Review qualified conversations before expanding outreach spend.; label: Days 22-30; value: Audit the pilot and rehearse a failed-closing response.; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Review actual mandate progress, reconcile the cash ledger, and test document retrieval, milestone alerts, payment-change callbacks, and a canceled transaction. Assign remediation owners and revise the next 30-day work plan using observed conversion evidence.

text.title: Thirty Days to a Documented Brokerage Operating System
text.tspan: Thirty Days to a Documented Brokerage Operating System

circle.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Define the niche, permitted activities, and cash constraints.; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Select one asset category and operating jurisdiction; document license and securities analysis, excluded activities, escrow arrangements, and a 13-week cash forecast. Complete the four statutory and risk checks before launching brokerage outreach.

text.title: Define the niche, permitted activities, and cash constraints.

circle.title: label: Days 8-14; value: Install the mandate packet and controlled evidence workflow.; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Prepare the exclusive engagement, scoped NCNDA, agency disclosures, seller questionnaire, buyer qualification checklist, and document index. Configure HubSpot stages and SharePoint access, then test a sample record without real client funds.

text.title: Install the mandate packet and controlled evidence workflow.

circle.title: label: Days 15-21; value: Run a bounded owner-research and buyer-matching pilot.; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Research 25 relevant owners and 15 plausible buyers as activity targets, not conversion promises. Log authority, sector fit, acquisition criteria, contact permissions, and evidence gaps. Review qualified conversations before expanding outreach spend.

text.title: Run a bounded owner-research and buyer-matching pilot.

circle.title: label: Days 22-30; value: Audit the pilot and rehearse a failed-closing response.; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Review actual mandate progress, reconcile the cash ledger, and test document retrieval, milestone alerts, payment-change callbacks, and a canceled transaction. Assign remediation owners and revise the next 30-day work plan using observed conversion evidence.

text.title: Audit the pilot and rehearse a failed-closing response.

Assumptions: Numeric values are cumulative milestone days: 7, 14, 21, and 30. Work begins only within an authorized service scope. Licensing, seller readiness, and diligence can extend the schedule. The canonical first-deal window remains 3–12 months; these milestones do not forecast commission receipts.
